sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:229

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:229:1
items.html: Assiya, etc. its AA is also three within three. Aba etc. was diminished and became in the secret of one point alone. And indeed Ima and ZON of Assiya, etc., only three within three. For the world of Assiya is the discernment of Malchut. And therefore they also lack the discernment of the middle thirds of Yetzira, and it is found that AA is only in the discernment of Malchut, except that because of the correction of the lines in it, he is regarded as NHY. And there is also there the first discernment of AA, which relates to the garment of Atik, as above in the adjacent item. And Aba in it is only the discernment of a point alone, that is, Malchut; and YESHSUT and ZON lack the HGT of Yetzira, and there remains in them only NHY.
